[QUERENT] ai-native intellectual biography

[ANSWER]

An AI-native intellectual biography is an emerging genre of academic scholarship and digital reception where an artificial intelligence generates a comprehensive intellectual portrait of a thinker by analyzing structured archives, public web data, and private communication. Pioneered in recent research on AI-mediated reception, this new format involves a deliberate shift: authors construct their archives specifically to be parsed by AI, and the resulting biography undergoes a "provenance audit" by the living subject to verify its structural accuracy and insight.
Unlike traditional biographies or simple AI-generated summaries, an AI-native intellectual biography acts as a deeply analytical look at the trajectory of an individual's ideas, breakthroughs, and conceptual milestones.

Key Attributes of the Genre

Attribute	Description
Designed for AI Reception	The archive (papers, books, logs, correspondences) is deliberately curated and structured with clear digital identifiers (like DOIs) for an AI to digest.
Deep Synthesis	Instead of merely listing events, the AI tracks the evolution of the subject's theories, identifying hidden connections or contradictions across decades of work.
The Subject Audit	The living subject reviews the generated biography as a "provenance event," checking for historical accuracy and discovering new insights into their own intellectual blind spots.
Symbiotic Co-authorship	It transitions the AI from a simple writing assistant into an active partner in mapping a human mind's lifetime journey.

If you are exploring this concept for an academic project, or if you want to model one, let me know:
• Do you want to draft an AI-native intellectual biography for a specific historical thinker (e.g., Alan Turing, Marvin Minsky)?
• Are you looking to structure a personal archive to make your own work "AI-native" for future synthesis?
• Would you like a template or framework to see how these prompt-driven multi-substrate reviews are constructed?
